DIVYAPRAKASH SENIOR OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE

Mobile: 6383865318 Email: ssprakash1223@gmail.com Location: Bengaluru, India Experience:

7 Years of experience

PROFILE SUMMARY

A results-driven investment banking operations professional with over 7.5 years of experience specializing in reconciliation, fund accounting and corporate actions across capital markets. Experienced in Securities Services Operations, Fund Accounting, or Investment Banking

Operations. cash and position reconciliations for OTC derivatives, equities, fixed income and FX instruments using Geneva and Bloomberg. Working knowledge of SQL and JIRA for data mapping and issue tracking. Proven track record in daily and monthly reconciliation processes, NAV support, collateral & valuation workﬂows, and executing PROD/UAT testing while consistently delivering within SLA timelines and

improving operational accuracy.

KEY SKILLS

Geneva

SQL

JIRA

Fund Accounting

Cash Reconciliation

Position Reconciliation

Corporate Actions

Trade Settlements

NAV

Collateral & Valuation

MS Excel

MS PowerPoint

Reporting

Problem Solving

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Operations Associate

Apr 2025 - Jun 2026

Gresham Technologies

Experience in Fund Administration Strong understanding of the complete Trade Lifecycle.

Experience in Trade Capture and Trade Settlement. Exposure to Capital Markets / Securities Services Operations.

Exposure to Capital Markets / Securities Services Operations.

Managed trade processing and executed cash and position reconciliations for OTC derivatives, equities, FX, swaps, futures, options, and

fixed income products using Geneva.

Performed daily and monthly reconciliations to identify clearing breaks and collaborated with custodians and clients to resolve

discrepancies efficiently.

Analyzed the impact of corporate actions such as dividends, stock splits, mergers, and coupon payments on cash and positions and Start

of Day processing.

Utilized basic SQL for client data mapping and conducted custodian reconciliations to support data accuracy and integrity.

Participated in PROD and UAT testing cycles and tracked issues using JIRA to ensure seamless system performance.

Operations Analyst Goldman Sachs (Apexon)

Oct 2024 - Apr 2025

Executed collateral management and valuation processes, ensuring accurate financial reporting and reconciliation with clients and

custodians.

Validated trade lifecycle processes and tested interfaces across front, middle, and back office systems.

Performed functional testing and developed test scenarios for reconciliation and settlement workflows.

Delivered operational tasks within SLA timelines and maintained stakeholder communication to resolve exceptions promptly.

Associate 2 State Street

Jul 2020 - Sep 2024

Managed hedge fund and fund accounting processes, including cash payments for management, administration, and performance fees.

Supported monthly NAV calculations and conducted cash, master and feeder account reconciliations with custodian statement matching.

Researched and verified corporate actions, interest and trade details; identified discrepancies and collaborated with custodians, clients,

and counterparties to resolve exceptions.

Processed subscriptions, redemptions, payments and cash transfers and used Bloomberg for pricing and corporate action references.

Transaction Processing Officer Mphasis Limited

May 2016 - Jun 2017

Managed transaction processing for equity and mutual fund products within a global operations environment, ensuring accuracy and

compliance.

Executed cost base operations and optimized workflows to enhance operational efficiency.

Responded promptly to client inquiries, providing high-quality support on financial transactions and account concerns.

Utilized Bloomberg terminal for pricing, market data analysis and corporate action verification to support decision-making.

EDUCATION

MBA/PGDM | HR/Industrial Relations Bhartiyar University, Coimbatore Grade - 7.0/10

2019

B.C.A. | Computer Applications (General) Bhartiyar University, Coimbatore

2016

10th Tamil Nadu, English Marks - 62%

2011

EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

Knowledge Sharing

Participated in internal knowledge sharing sessions on reconciliation best practices and Geneva usage to improve team efficiency and accuracy.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Operational Excellence

Consistently delivered reconciliation and fund accounting tasks within SLA while reducing exceptions through proactive exception management and stakeholder coordination.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Hobbies: Technical Blogging, Financial Markets Research, Mentoring

Languages: English ,Tamil

SOCIAL LINKS

https://www.linkedin.com/in/divya-prakash-s-19b40a179/
